limits: New typed interfaces are not native ABI-compatible object/vtable overlays.
Queue/model callbacks are noexcept; existing camera destruction can throw. First bounded bridge requires nonthrowing terminal dependencies. Full native callback-EH parity is separate work.
Missing/unsupported bindings must not silently succeed. Never swallow destruction errors, reset a count or fall back to a guessed destructor.
Publish queued references only after successful native construction; unsupported current vtable profiles or zero-count resurrection are outside concrete camera bridge.
Stable active queue slots/captured camera and hierarchy objects remain required across callbacks; no concurrent mutation.
Valid nonnegative raw array bounds and actual nonnull light/attachment/child bindings required; pointer and capacity remain native state.
The companion cannot be retired at logical release while queued references remain. Raw count alone does not extend a separately destroyed C++ companion lifetime.
